QF.id: III-C Prevention of Money Laundering Act_4

question.text: Under Section 5 of the PMLA, property may be provisionally attached for a period not exceeding:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under PMLA, the Director may order attachment of property for a period not exceeding 180 days from the date of the order (NISM-Series-III-C workbook, p.160). The Trap: 60, 90, and 365 days do not match the not-exceeding-180-days ceiling stated on p.160. Note: Anchor on the source-backed 180-day ceiling from p.160 rather than comparing to provisional-attachment periods used in other statutes.
